quest.title: Like Seeds on the Wind
quest.description: Just as people hoped, this post is still thriving, like seeds on the wind...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight! Thanks to you, this post's finally starting to look the part.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: ...Now, even if we're attacked while the whole camp's dead drunk, we'll be able to hold out 'til I sober up.

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Saw right through me? Did you learn all my tells without even trying, Honorary Knight?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: More like we've gotten used to your nonsense without even trying!

dialogues.speaker: Varka
dialogues.text: Ha! Still, when I'm not on watch, that's when it's time to crack open a cask! You're always welcome here.
